Inferred from "-" on the 2024-04-04 capture and today's table listing only 3/5/10 yr; corroborated by the 基準金利 link now split by contract date (2024-10-01 onward) and the post-2024-10 base-rate series covering 3/5/10 yr only, which points to a revision for contracts from 2024-10-01. No notice states a withdrawal.

status_source: Live product page saved 2026-11-17 (sources/nwl/pages/product_2026-11-17.html) is still published with rate links and 18 distributors.
notes: All rate data comes from the Wayback Machine (via_wayback=true) except the 2026-11-16 period, which comes from the live pages (via_wayback=false, sources/nwl/rates/): saved by hand from a browser on 2026-11-17, and read directly by `scripts/nwl.py --live` since 2026-11-17 (commit 54b0b5b; the pages that run saved carry the Japan date 2026-11-18, file names *_2026-11-18.*). nw-life.co.jp only answers from some networks (HTTP 403 elsewhere); a connection in Japan, a VPN included, reaches it.

Raw Wayback captures are the id_ form (original HTML as served, no Wayback rewriting) saved under sources/nwl/wayback/ and listed in captures.csv with sha256; the normal rewritten form was never needed.

Each capture of the shared 積立利率 page shows only the then-current half-month 適用期間 (rates set on the 1st and 16th). effective_date is the first day of that period. There are 17 crediting-rate dates, 2020-07-01 to 2026-11-16 with large gaps: no data before 2020-07-01 and none for periods between captures. Nothing is interpolated.
Captures skipped: 20190721002454 (bot-block stub, no data) and 20240523151615 (archived HTTP 403 page). Distinct captures that repeat an already-recorded 適用期間 add 0 points.

Plan key encoding: term_years is always 据置期間 (blank where the table has none). age_band is the 契約時の被保険者年齢 band as printed (0-69, 70-79, 0-84, 85-92 ...); blank for the 2020-2022 USD 確定年金 layout, which had no age bands.
判定年数 (AⅡ型 and 豪ドル建 確定年金) is encoded in the plan key as _h<band>: a2_jpy_h5-6, h7-9, h10-12, h13-17, h18-life; aud_kakutei_hle5 (5年以下), h6-7, h8-9, h10, hge11 (11年以上). 判定年数 = 据置期間 + 年金受取期間/2 (floor).

USD 年金額確定特約付 確定年金 (期間指定型): plan usd_kakutei_p<N> where N = 年金受取期間 in years (5/10/20), term_years = 据置期間. Life-annuity payout types: usd_shushin / aud_shushin = 年金総額保証付終身年金・純粋終身年金; usd_atsu / aud_atsu = 年金総額保証付後厚終身年金.
豪ドル建 終身 tables publish one row for several 据置期間 (0・1年; 3・5・10・15・20年); the collector writes one point per 据置期間 with the same published value.

Tontine (年金重視/生存保障重視, 生存保障重視特則付指定通貨建個人年金保険): plan tontine, currency JPY/USD/AUD in one CSV, term_years = 据置期間, age bands 0-84 and 85-92 (older captures show other bands). Rates are those of contracts dated 2024-10-01 or later.

基準金利 (base_rate): AⅡ型 page gu_int_rate12_base covers contracts dated 2024-10-01 or later only (older contracts must phone the call centre); 米ドル建 gu_int_rate13_base; 豪ドル建 gu_int_rate_base; tontine gu_int_rate15_base = contracts from 2024-10-01 (plan tontine) and gu_int_rate5_base = contracts up to 2024-09-30 (plan tontine_pre2410, which lists longer 据置期間 up to 20 years). The base-rate pages were captured far less often than the rate page (AⅡ and tontine from 2025-06; USD from 2026-06; AUD from 2019-12). Only the current period appears on each capture.
Status '-' cells (not offered, e.g. AⅡ型 short 判定年数 in 2022, 豪ドル建 70-89 at ≤5 years) are recorded as status not_offered with a blank value.

The 積立利率 page is shared by all products; the sections used are a2, dd, tg and sh (matched by heading text). The 指定通貨建個人年金保険 section (sk, sold with a 3,000万円 premium split) is a different product and is not collected, nor are 年金増額特約 variants.
The 2024-10-01 contract-date cohort split on the AⅡ型 page affects only the 基準金利/市場価格調整率 lookup, not the published 積立利率 table.

Distributors: the 18 institutions listed on the live product page (2026-11-17); the 2026-05-24 Wayback capture listed 13. Plans offered may vary by distributor; bank-specific product names are not collected.

Documents: the live brochures (yuyu_advance2.pdf and yuyu_advance2-02.pdf, saved 2026-11-17) are the current versions. The Wayback copies are older and may be out of date; the Wayback brochure (2025-02-18) and the attention PDFs and brochure_02 (2021-04-12) are truncated at exactly 1 MiB (no %%EOF) and flagged INCOMPLETE in the manifest. The しおり・約款 PDFs are the latest archived (2023-04 editions, tontine 2023-05-08), most likely superseded; the 年金増額特約 しおり (shiori n0e, n0o) were not downloaded.
Not collected: MVA formulas, loads, 為替レート pages, 予定利率 table, net yield, a Wayback capture of 基準金利 20260218201551 was initially refused by rate limiting and was retrieved on a re-run.
The 年金受取期間 and 契約時の被保険者年齢 eligibility limits per 据置期間 in the life-annuity tables (e.g. 16歳～69歳) are kept as printed in age_band.
Plans ending _shushin and _atsu are annuity payout types (年金総額保証付終身年金・純粋終身年金, 年金総額保証付後厚終身年金) inside the deferred annuity, not whole-life insurance.
For Wayback rows of this product, retrieved_date is the capture date; for other insurers' Wayback rows it is the date the capture was downloaded.

Launch: on sale from 2019-04-01 at Oita Bank, Shizuoka Bank and Musashino Bank, from the insurer's news release 『悠々時間アドバンス２』を販売開始 (snapshot sources/nwl/pages/release_n190401_2026-11-17.pdf, retrieved 2026-11-17). It supersedes the earlier trade-press date of 2019-06-03, which was the start at Hokuyo Bank (shinnihon-ins.co.jp industry news 2019-06-04), a later distributor. The release adds the survival-weighted plan to 悠々時間アドバンス (a switch from the earlier edition). Status on_sale rests on the live product page saved 2026-11-17 and a 2026-05-24 Wayback capture.
notes_en: The insurer's site only answers from some networks, such as a connection in Japan; from there the collector reads it directly.
History is archive captures on scattered dates from 2020; gaps are not filled.
Which Yuyu Jikan variant the owner's sheet refers to is an assumption; the survival-weighted rates are the same across variants.

In the USD life annuity the youngest entry age rises as the deferral shortens (6 to 69 with 10 years' deferral, 16 to 69 with none), so age bands such as 6-69 and 11-69 are as printed; AUD rates near 1% in 2019 and 2020 are also as printed in archived copies of the time.
Launch date (1 April 2019) is from the insurer's news release; an earlier note gave 3 June 2019 from trade press, which was a later distributor start.
Four archived documents are incomplete copies and are marked as such; the two current brochures are complete.
Base rates before October 2024 policies are not published for most forms.
The survival-weighted (tontine) plan now shows only 3, 5 and 10-year deferrals; the other deferrals appear to have been withdrawn for contracts from October 2024.
